title: Living HUD
description: Brings a little life into your HUD! Unfinished.
body:
This is a simple resource pack that will breathe some life into your HUD! All your HUD elements now have little faces. They react based on your armor, HP, and food values.


*I will not be held responsible if your HUD elements become evil and start stabbing you and your loved ones.


"They are sentient, of course."

-GLADoS, April 19, 2011
